violations.text: The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher was 0 parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. PIC placed an out of order sign on unit. Establishment may use dishwasher for washing and rinsing, but MUST use 3 bay sink for sanitizing. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/21/2026
Inspector observed cooked mixed vegetables arriving from caterer at 112F. PIC called caterer and turned on oven to reheat mixed vegetables. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/01/2025
Inspector observed American cheese past the 7 day date marking. PIC disposed of cheese. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/01/2025
The non-food contact surfaces of metal pan lids contain original stickers. PIC informed to remove stickers and rewash metal lids. New Violation. Correct By: 05/12/2025
The cabinet under food prep sink in the kitchen area is in poor repair (previous water damage). The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 06/30/2025

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. New Violation. Correct By: 02/13/2024
Inspector observed missing ceiling tiles in dry storage area. Physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 11/01/2023
